# SONIK Web Design

> SONIK Web Design е студио за изработка на сайтове, онлайн магазини, SEO и видимост в AI търсачки, 3D и motion дизайн. Базирано е в София, България, и работи с клиенти в България, Великобритания и САЩ. Специализация: сайтове за барбершопи и салони. Сайт: https://sonikwebdesign.com/ · Имейл: sonikwebco@gmail.com
>
> SONIK Web Design is a web design studio based in Sofia, Bulgaria. It builds websites, online stores, SEO and AI search visibility, and 3D & motion design for clients in Bulgaria, the UK and the USA, with a specialism in barbershop and salon websites.

## Основни страници / Main pages

- [Начална страница (български)](https://sonikwebdesign.com/): услуги, цени, проекти, въпроси и отговори.
- [Home page (English)](https://sonikwebdesign.com/en.html): services, selected work and FAQ.

## Услуги / Services

- [Barbershop website design](https://sonikwebdesign.com/barbershop-website-design.html) · [Сайт за барбершоп](https://sonikwebdesign.com/sait-za-barbershop.html): barber profiles, direct booking through Booksy, TheCut, Square or Cal.com, galleries and an owner panel.
- [Website design](https://sonikwebdesign.com/website-design.html) · [Изработка на сайт](https://sonikwebdesign.com/izrabotka-na-sait.html): landing pages and company websites. В България: лендинг страница от 200 €, фирмен сайт от 450 €.
- [Online store development](https://sonikwebdesign.com/online-store-development.html) · [Изработка на онлайн магазин](https://sonikwebdesign.com/onlain-magazin.html): catalogue, Stripe checkout, automated invoices, back-office system. В България: от 900 €.
- [SEO & AI search visibility](https://sonikwebdesign.com/seo-ai-search-visibility.html) · [SEO и AI видимост](https://sonikwebdesign.com/seo-optimizacia.html): technical audit, Schema.org structured data, llms.txt, Google Search Console, local SEO. Custom quote.
- 3D и motion дизайн / 3D & motion design: logo animations, 3D visuals, promotional videos. Custom quote.

Clients outside Bulgaria receive a custom quote. Domain, hosting and paid licences are not included.

## Проекти / Case studies

- [210 Barber Studio](https://sonikwebdesign.com/case-study-210-barber-studio.html): website for a 17-barber shop in San Antonio, Texas, with per-barber booking links and an owner panel. Live: https://210barberstudio.com
- [Exclusive Barbershop](https://sonikwebdesign.com/case-study-exclusive-barbershop.html): barbershop website in the USA with booking through Booksy and TheCut. Live: https://exclusive-barbershop.com
- [New Shade](https://sonikwebdesign.com/case-study-new-shade.html): SONIK's own venture — online store for made-to-order sun-shading louvres with Stripe checkout, virtual office, automated invoices and first-party analytics. Live: https://new-shade.com
- [Woodra A-Frame](https://sonikwebdesign.com/case-study-woodra-a-frame.html): website for two A-frame guest houses near Berkovitsa, Bulgaria. Live: https://woodra-aframe.com
- [MAISON D’OR](https://sonikwebdesign.com/case-study-maison-dor.html): showcase for a premium Slavic hair brand.
- [Българа](https://sonikwebdesign.com/case-study-bulgara.html): website for a Bulgarian folklore ensemble.
- [Olga Rusakova](https://sonikwebdesign.com/case-study-olga-rusakova.html): personal brand website for an aesthetic cosmetologist in Varna.
- [DANI CUTS](https://sonikwebdesign.com/case-study-dani-cuts.html): hair studio website in Pernik with online booking through Cal.com.
- NIMA Optical: website for an optician.
